title: Billing Desk Limits on Credits and Refunds, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
These Water Damage Mitigation limits govern the billing desk's corrections and refunds: the dispute window for billing-error and duplicate-line credits, the goodwill credit cap per job and the refund processing period.

| Tier | Dispute window (calendar days) | Goodwill credit cap per job | Refund processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 60 | $150.00 | 10 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 60 | $300.00 | 10 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 60 | $150.00 | 10 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 60 | $300.00 | 10 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | 60 | $200.00 | 10 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | 60 | $400.00 | 10 |

## Definitions
- **Dispute window**: Days after the final invoice date within which a billing-error or duplicate-line dispute may be credited, calendar days.
- **Goodwill credit cap**: Maximum total goodwill credit the desk may post on one job, USD.
- **Refund processing**: Business days (Monday-Friday excluding company holidays) to issue an overpayment refund after it is approved, count.

## Notes
- The goodwill credit cap is the only limit here that varies by tier: it is higher on Large Loss tiers than on Standard Loss tiers and highest on Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss.
- The dispute window and the refund processing period are the same on all six tiers.
